gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.korstguh: Rarity: Uncommon (only in the Holey Cheese Hills)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.korstguh: A holey-cheese-yellow guh with a shield of baked rind that he fits into completely. Once tamed he rolls up into a little ball when you sneak next to him: give the ball a push or a tap and off he goes! He likes his naps best in a cheese hole.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.duinguh: Rarity: Uncommon (only in the Rind Desert)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.duinguh: A sand-colored guh with enormous ears. He never sinks into crumb sand: he runs right across it. Once tamed he digs himself into crumb sand until all you can see is his little ears. That's how he keeps watch. Or takes a nap, who can tell.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kruimelguh: Rarity: Rare (only in the Crumb Clouds)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kruimelguh: A cream-white guh full of crumbs, with a little cloud on his back. He is so light that he stays standing on crumb clouds and floats down ever so slowly when he steps off an island. He couldn't fall if he tried, and he does try.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schimmelguh: Rarity: Rare (only on the Blue Cheese Plains)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schimmelguh: A pale guh with little blue veins, just like blue-veined cheese, and glowing little mushrooms on his head and back. Once tamed he glows like a little lamp that walks along with you. He smells a bit strong. Best not to mention it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kristalguh: Rarity: Rare (only on the Crystal Cheese Cliffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kristalguh: A cliff-cheese-gray guh with golden cheese crystals growing out of him. He has a nose for anything shiny: once tamed he sniffs up a Crystal Cheese Nugget now and then, one a day at most. He even hands it over. Usually.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.koorguh: Rarity: Rare (only in the Nibble Chorus Forest)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.koorguh: A purple guh with a nibble chorus flower on his head and a neat white choir collar. Once tamed he sings along at the top of his lungs as soon as a music disc plays. Off-key, but with feeling. At the Disco Dynamo's party he counts for two.

gui.guhs.einde2_biomeguhs.getemd.kristal: %s is yours! Now and then he sniffs up a Crystal Cheese Nugget for you.

ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomeguhs_kor: In the &6Holey Cheese Hills&r of the Guh End the &6Rind Guhs&r roll around: holey-cheese yellow, with a shield of rind. Tame one with cheese nibbles. Sneak next to him and he rolls up into a little ball you can push away. Nyeg, he likes it!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomeguhs_dui: In the dry &6Rind Desert&r lives the &6Dune Guh&r, with ears you could make a sail out of. Tame one. Let him stand still on &7crumb sand&r and he digs himself in: only his little ears still stick out.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomeguhs_kru: High up in the &6Crumb Clouds&r the &6Crumb Guh&r drifts from island to island. He simply stands on the crumb clouds you sink through, and floats down ever so slowly. Tame one!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomeguhs_sch: Something is glowing in the mist of the &6Blue Cheese Plains&r. It is a &6Blue Cheese Guh&r: blue-veined cheese with little mushrooms. Tame one and you will never need a torch again: he glows like a lamp and walks along with you.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomeguhs_kri: On the &6Crystal Cheese Cliffs&r the &6Crystal Guh&r glitters, with a little crown of cheese crystal. Tame one. Now and then he sniffs up a &6Crystal Cheese Nugget&r for you: one a day at most, so make it last.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomeguhs_koo: Among the singing plants of the &6Nibble Chorus Forest&r one of them sings back: the &6Chorus Guh&r, choir collar and all. Tame one, put on a &7music disc&r and listen. Nyeg-nyeg-nyeeeeg!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomeguhs_all: Every land of the outer islands has its own guh. Tame all six: the &6Rind Guh&r, the &6Dune Guh&r, the &6Crumb Guh&r, the &6Blue Cheese Guh&r, the &6Crystal Guh&r and the &6Chorus Guh&r. Each gets a page of its own in your Guhdex.
